_meta.note: Hard filters run before scoring. A candidate that fails one is not a low-scoring option, it is not an option — weighted averages otherwise let a great vector index paper over 'a second process cannot open the file'.
_meta.scale: every criterion is scored 0-5; see schema.md for what each score means

hard_filters.test: two or more independent OS processes can write concurrently without data loss
hard_filters.why: the literal question being asked — several agents share one VPS

hard_filters.test: upstream is neither archived nor dormant as of 2026-08
hard_filters.why: an agent's memory outlives a hype cycle; an archived engine is a migration already scheduled

hard_filters.test: runs on the VPS with no mandatory cloud dependency for writes
hard_filters.why: Jod's charter: every dependency is a local process or a local file

hard_filters.test: idle resident footprint under ~400 MB on a 4 vCPU / 8 GB box
hard_filters.why: the database is a supporting cast member; the agents need the RAM

hard_filters.test: can be the authoritative home for agent state, not only an index or a policy layer over one
hard_filters.why: failing this is not a criticism — it means the thing is a complement to the answer rather than the answer. Sync layers, ANN libraries and memory frameworks all land here.

criteria.concurrency: measured multi-writer throughput and error rate under contention
criteria.correctness: measured: zero lost updates on contended read-modify-write, and a safe default
criteria.latency: measured p50/p99 on the hot path an agent actually waits on
criteria.recall: measured vector search quality and speed at Jod's scale
criteria.breadth: how much of {events, state, vectors, full-text, graph} one engine covers
criteria.ops_burden: inverse of daemons to run, back up, upgrade and monitor
criteria.local_first: keeps working, and stays inspectable, with no network and no daemon
criteria.rust_fit: quality of the Rust client story for jod-core
criteria.queryability: can an agent compose an ad-hoc query at runtime it did not plan for
criteria.survival: likelihood the project is still maintained in three years

charter.label: Jod's charter as written
charter.description: Local-first, low ops burden, correctness over speed. The weighting implied by docs/jod-system.md.

throughput.label: Many agents, write-heavy
throughput.description: Assume 20+ concurrent agents streaming events. Concurrency and latency dominate.

simplicity.label: Fewest moving parts
simplicity.description: One artefact to back up, nothing to run. Optimises for a system one person maintains.

recall-first.label: Memory quality above all
recall-first.description: Assume the brain grows to millions of notes and retrieval quality is the product.
